# Withholding Tax Rates

Manage withholding tax rates in Teamleader Focus.

```php
Teamleader::withholdingTaxRates()
```

| | |
|---|---|
| Class | `McoreServices\TeamleaderSDK\Resources\Invoicing\WithholdingTaxRates` |
| Create / update / delete | — / — / — |
| Pagination | No |

## Endpoints

- `withholdingTaxRates.list`

## Filters

Passed as the first argument to `list()`. Any other key throws.

| Filter | Description |
|---|---|
| `department_id` | Filter by department UUID |

## Methods

### `list()`

```php
list(array $filters = [], array $options = []): array
```

List withholding tax rates

`department_id` is the one filter. Before v2.2.7 list() ignored its
arguments entirely, so a department filter returned every rate.

- `$filters` — department_id
- `$options` — Not supported — the endpoint has no paging or sorting

**Throws** `\InvalidArgumentException` On an unknown filter, or any paging or sorting option

### `forDepartment()`

```php
forDepartment(string $departmentId): array
```

List withholding tax rates for one department

### `find()`

```php
find(string $id): ?array
```

Find a withholding tax rate by ID

- `$id` — Withholding tax rate UUID

### `findByRate()`

```php
findByRate(float $rate): ?array
```

Find a withholding tax rate by exact rate value

- `$rate` — Withholding tax rate (e.g., 0.15 for 15%)

### `findByRateRange()`

```php
findByRateRange(float $minRate, float $maxRate): array
```

Find withholding tax rates by rate range

- `$minRate` — Minimum rate (inclusive)
- `$maxRate` — Maximum rate (inclusive)

### `findByDescription()`

```php
findByDescription(string $description, bool $exactMatch = true): ?array
```

Find a withholding tax rate by description

- `$description` — Withholding tax rate description (e.g., "15%")
- `$exactMatch` — Whether to match exactly or search partial

## Examples

Get all withholding tax rates:

```php
$rates = Teamleader::withholdingTaxRates()->list();
```

Find withholding tax rate by exact rate value:

```php
$rate = Teamleader::withholdingTaxRates()->findByRate(0.15);
```

Find withholding tax rate by description:

```php
$rate = Teamleader::withholdingTaxRates()->findByDescription("15%");
```

Get withholding tax rates as key-value pairs for dropdowns:

```php
$options = Teamleader::withholdingTaxRates()->asOptions();
```
